build_remote_client_state: build a RemoteClientState instance to track remote client state and handle VR input for HITL simulation
get_head_pose: get the head pose position and quaternion for a specified user index from client state history
get_hand_pose: get the hand pose position and quaternion for a specified user and hand index from client state
update_client_state: call update to fetch latest remote client states, process connections, and update GUI input state
kick_users: kick remote users matching a specified user mask by sending a kick signal to the networking thread
